glossary.trust: Trust: how much Ms. Hanh believes your reports. Good, well-sourced reports raise it; wrong, over-confident ones lower it. At zero you are fired.
glossary.energy: Energy: how many verification checks you can run today. Each paid check uses 1 Energy and half an hour. Repeat checks on the same article are free.
glossary.tier_chinh_thuc: Official: central bank, regulators and statistics offices. Usually reliable, sometimes slow.
glossary.tier_bao_chi: Press: newspapers. Fairly reliable but may exaggerate.
glossary.tier_mang_xa_hoi: Social media: fast but often rumor. Verify before you rely on it.
glossary.tier_noi_bo: Insider: colleagues and tips. Early but unconfirmed.

tutorial.name: Ms. Hanh
tutorial.deadline: From today every report has a deadline. Each check takes time. Send before 15:00 or the market may move and your reward is cut.
tutorial.done: Tutorial finished. Tap the Help icon to see it again.

steps.text: This is today's question. Your job: forecast the answer using the news.
Open Browser to read the news. Colored badges show how much to trust each source.
Click a news card to select it.
Open Code Pad to verify the selected article.
Press Use. Each check costs Energy (the dots) and you only get a few a day.
Pin the articles you trust. Go back to Browser and press Pin.
Open Mail to write your report.
Pick a forecast and how confident you are.
Press Send. You cannot edit afterwards.

review.title: Today's truth
say: Here is today's news and the truth behind it.
Here is what really happened today.
review.bankrupt: The company ran out of money.
review.line_late: You were late. The market had already moved by then.
review.line_missed: No report by the deadline. That counts as nothing.
review.timing_late: Timing: LATE. The reward is cut.
review.timing_missed: Timing: MISSED. Counts as not delivered.
review.shifted: The market moved after the 15:00 update: the answer changed from %s to %s.

boss_lines.right: Good. Keep stating your confidence like that.
boss_lines.wrong_low: Wrong, but you warned us you were unsure. Noted.
boss_lines.wrong_mid: Wrong. You were only moderately sure, but I still need better evidence.
boss_lines.wrong_high: You sounded certain. Now the company is paying for it.
boss_lines.partial: Close. Next time I need more evidence.
boss_lines.warning: This is a warning. I need evidence in your report, not gut feeling.
boss_lines.promotion: Starting next week you move up. Don't make me regret it.
boss_lines.demotion: I have to move you down a level. Redo it carefully.
boss_lines.fired: I'm sorry, but the company can't survive if this continues.
boss_lines.bankrupt: The company has no money left to operate. This is not down to one report.
boss_lines.survived_won: The company is still standing. Thank you for staying.
boss_lines.survived_lost: The company survives, but I don't yet see you steady enough for more responsibility.
